purpose: Teach: 翠/ギャング/ロータリー/ネイチャー/ジェーン/電撃/スパイラル/イングリッシュ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヒスイ、つまり翠色の置物をお祝いに下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is giving you a jade ornament as a gift to celebrate.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful. Soft voice, as though she's sharing a small tender detail about someone she admires. Gentle pacing. A slight lift at the end — genuine happiness for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ギャング映画は大人になってから」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me I can't watch gangster movies until I'm older.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, but with an undertone of acceptance. Not complaining — just reporting something his father said. Small, natural voice. A tiny pause before the second thought, as though he's processing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロータリークラブの寄付活動を続けてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is still involved with the Rotary Club's charity work.
lines.style: Observant and appreciative. Quiet admiration in the tone. Speaks as though noticing something kind about him. Unhurried, with a gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとネイチャー誌の野生動物特集観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a nature documentary with Dad — all about wildlife.
lines.style: Bright with genuine enthusiasm. Light, unforced excitement in his voice. Each phrase lands with simple delight. No performance, just honest joy at the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェーン・オースティンの絵本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father reads you Jane Austen picture books.
lines.style: Soft, tender appreciation. Voice drops slightly — intimate, as though she's sharing something precious and a little bit funny. Affectionate, with a hint of amusement at the pairing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「電撃結婚」ってドラマのお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about this drama called 'Sudden Wedding.'
lines.style: Eager and open. Natural curiosity in his voice — he's sharing something he learned. Slightly faster pace, energetic but not loud. A small lift of interest at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「景気のスパイラル下降は怖い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying that downturns in the economy are frightening.
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly weighted. Slower pace, as though she's translating something serious he said. Thoughtful and grounded. No drama — just the quiet gravity of an adult's concern.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとイングリッシュガーデンに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to an English garden together.
lines.style: Pleased and content. Warm recollection in his voice. Unhurried pacing, with a gentle satisfaction at the memory. Quiet closure — not triumphant, just happy to have had it.
